root_cause: The payment-service container is stopped. order-service depends on payment-service for payment processing; with payment-service unreachable, order-service receives connection refused errors and returns HTTP 502/500 to callers
expected_fix: Restart payment-service with: docker start payment-service (or python infra/manage.py up). Implement circuit breakers and fallback logic in order-service to handle upstream outages gracefully
